articleTitle: Facial Sentiment Classification Based on Resnet-18 Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Recently, human-computer interaction is become increasingly common in daily life, in which facial expression recognition has a wide application potential. At present, the state-of-the-art accuracy of facial expression classification based on the Kaggle database is only 71.20%, which still indicates some room for improvement. Based on the resnet-18 model, we find that a large number of parameters in the model are prone to over-fitting, which hinders the face recognition accuracy. In this paper, we propose a modified network model based on the resnet18-network, in which we change the original average pooling layer to a global average pooling layer with a double convolution layer. Our experiment result suggests that our model outperformed the state-of-the-art results showing a 1.49% increase in accuracy on the Kaggle database.

articleTitle: ISAR Image Matching and 3D Reconstruction Based on Improved SIFT Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, the matching problem of inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) image sequences and three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction problem are analyzed. Firstly, this paper proposes an improved image matching algorithm based on Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), which realizes the association of feature points of ISAR image sequences. In the new algorithm, the transformation matrix between images is calculated. Compared with the traditional SIFT matching algorithm, the problem of few matching points is resolved, and the number of associated points is increased. Then, using the matrix factorization method, the 3D position matrix is decomposed from the observation matrix to realize the 3D reconstruction of the target. Finally, the effectiveness of the association and 3D reconstruction algorithms were verified using simulated aircraft data.

articleTitle: A Flexible Hardware Architecture for Slave Device of I2C Bus
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: I2C module is one of the most vital components in lots of chips. A flexible hardware architecture for slave device of I2C protocol is designed in this paper. The designed hardware architecture is divided into two levels: protocol level and application level. The protocol level implements the basic operations of I2C protocol, and the application level, which bases on the protocol level aiming to the demand of various applications. When complete the implementation and simulation of the designed hardware architecture, a verification platform is built to verify the performance of the designed hardware architecture.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Prediction and Decision Evaluation Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Under the active promotion of major countries in the world, the integration of AI and many fields has continued to deepen, and a series of new technologies, new formats and new models have emerged. The application of artificial intelligence algorithm for machine learning, to help government departments and institutions predict information related to the future, to provide decision-making advice. Based on the relevant data of the talent market in A city, this paper analyzes the supply and demand situation of local talents. The data is processed using wavelet threshold denoising and a NAR neural network model is established for prediction. Taking employment satisfaction, Chinese student employment rate and average salary as indicators, combined with GM (1,1) forecasting model to predict employment situation. The SOM neural network model is established based on the number of applicants, academic requirements, the number of students admitted, and the fast-growing industry in the A city. Finally, the paper compares the characteristics of the above-mentioned indicators in A city with other cities in China, and matches other cities with the same characteristics as the city A, and builds an "intelligent forecasting and decision-making evaluation model" to help government departments and related institutions predict future urban development.

articleTitle: Sentiment Classification of Tourism Based on Rules and LDA Topic Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Mastering the sentimental state of tourists can provide decision-making reference for scenic spot management and business operation. The core of tourist sentiment analysis is the construction of tourism sentiment classification model. At present, there is less research on emotions in the field of tourism, and the classification accuracy of the existing tourism sentiment model needs to be improved. Therefore, a method of combining sentiment lexicon and machine learning to construct tourism emotion model is presented. The tourist texts were collected from micro-blog and travel website reviews to construct tourism emotional lexicon firstly. By comparing the score of the single sentence text sentiment with threshold, the sentences with the clear emotion polarity were extracted, and we constructed a classifier preliminary with NB algorithm. Then the paper used the LDA topic model to correct the sentiment classification model, and the new model was used to classify of the other sentences. Finally, the two results were integrated as the end classification result. Through experiments on the Lijiang travel text, it is found that the accuracy of the hybrid method increased 13.85% than the sentiment lexicon method, and increased 8.51% than in machine learning.

articleTitle: Low Frequency Mechanical Antenna for Underwater Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Underwater wireless communication has broad application prospects of such areas as marine data collection, pollution monitoring, and auxiliary navigation. This paper proposes a mechanical antenna using a rotating permanent magnet as a transmitting unit, and according to the theoretical assumption, the prototype is made and the feasibility of the mechanical communication antenna is verified by experiments. Exploring low-frequency antennas with new radiation mechanisms from a new perspective and provides a new idea about the future miniaturization of low-frequency transmits antennas.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation Method of SAR Image Dataset Based on Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The published Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) samples are not abundant enough, which is not conducive to the application of deep learning methods in the field of SAR automatic target recognition. Generative Adversarial Nets (GANs) is one of the most effective ways to generate image samples. In this manuscript, the gradient penalty method was used on the traditional DCGAN to solve the mode collapse problem. The improved model was used for data augmentation of the MSTAR dataset. All the experimental results show that the method was an effective way to generate SAR images with high quality.

articleTitle: Dairy Cow Health Monitoring System Based on NB-IoT Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The cow breeding work has been using inefficient methods of artificial observation and physiological test to determine the estrus status of cows. Furthermore, these methods have disadvantages of high missed check possibilities for the estrus is usually long-cycled and has a very short duration. The cow estrus detection system is based on NB-IoT communication (Narrow-Band Internet of Things Communications). Some researches have shown that cows' exercise capacity and their physical status such as temperature will change significantly during their estrus. The system is used to discover the unusual changes of cows' physical status to determine the cows' estrus status and report to administrator in time. The system makes it possible to reduce workers' pressure and improve economic returns of pastures. The monitor worn on the neck records cow's physical status such as body temperature and exercise capacity and then upload to our server via NB-IoT communication modules. Furthermore, the data will be analyzed and processed by our application on android. Also, image recognition technology will be used to determine the cow's estrus behavior as a supportive method to improve the accuracy of our system.

articleTitle: An 8-12 GHz GaAs Limiter Based on PIN Diodes and Schottky Diodes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: An X-band limiter has been designed and tested in this paper. This limiter utilizes two-stage antipallel diode structure. Test results show that this limiter can work in 8-12GHz. Insertion loss is less than -0.5dB at 12GHz. Input return loss and output return loss are less than -14dB. Noise figure is less than 0.35dB. It can keep the output power below 13.6dBm with a maximal power input of 33.6dBm CW for 30minutes, no damage was observed. The actual size of the limiter is 1mm*0.7mm.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Encryption Algorithms Based on Data Deduplication Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous growth of science and technology in our country, we are exposed to more and more information. Computers are gradually coming into people's lives and constantly changing people's way of life. The scale of emerging services is expanding rapidly. Social networks, big data, Internet of Things and cloud computing are all developing rapidly. However, with the continuous development of the times, so far, the research of big data encryption algorithm has been far from meeting people's needs. With large-scale data volume and information volume, GB, TB and PB have far exceeded the general data statistics volume; at the same time, the surge of redundant data information is also significant. Therefore, it is imperative to solve the problem of redundant data information. In such a large scale of data sets, we should use scientific and effective methods to analyze data and make decisions, and create a stable big data analysis model to deal with the relationship between data.

articleTitle: A Method for Digital Modulation Recognition Based on Mixed Signal Features
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Digital modulation recognition is an important part of signal processing. With inherent anti-noise performance, High-Order Cumulants have natural advantage in recognizing digital modulation pattern, and is widely studied in the past several decades. On the basis of high-order cumulants, combined with peak feature of FFT spectrum and instantaneous signal feature, this paper proposed a new method for digital modulation recognition based on mixed signal features, which took advantage of classical decision-tree classifier. Simulation results showed that the method proposed in this paper can recognize six classical digital modulation pattern efficiently, and achieved satisfactory recognition result even at rather low SNR.

articleTitle: Design of the Multi-Band Artificial Magnetic Conductors Using the Circle Rings Embedded into a Square Ring
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, the compact multi-band artificial magnetic conductors (AMC) that embed the circle rings into the square ring are investigated. By employing the combination of different circle rings and a square ring, a number of zero-crossing points in the phase of AMC's reflection coefficient can be achieved. When three circle rings are embedded in a square ring, the five-band AMC is implemented, working at 1.3, 3.28, 5.02, 6.57, and 9.18 GHz, respectively. It is found that, by changing the number and sizes of the inner circle rings and the square ring's side length, we can realize the AMCs with different frequency bands. The designed AMCs can be used for the multi-band antennas, enhancing their impedance bandwidths and radiation performance.

articleTitle: Doppler Rate-of-Change Estimation Method for BPSK Signal Based on Spectrum Phase
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: When there is relative motion between the receiver and the emitting source, the emitter position can be determined by a single receiver with a single channel using Doppler rate-of-change received. In this passive localization application, accurate Doppler rate-of-change information is the key precondition to guarantee high localization precision. A new Doppler rate-of-change estimation method for BPSK signal based on spectrum phase is proposed in this paper using the special structure of the continuous signal by BPSK (Binary Phase Shift Keying) modulation. In the proposed method, the phase jump can be eliminated by the squaring operation to the received signal, and the signal is segmented to multiple shorter pieces of the same length. The central frequency is estimated from each signal piece by fast Fourier transformation. The spectrum phase can be obtained by doing Fourier transform at the central frequency of each signal piece. The Doppler rate-of-change was estimated using the linear minimum mean square criterion. The effectiveness of the proposed method was proved by the computer simulation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Demodulation Method for Communication Signals Based on Multi-Layer Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of signal demodulation under noise interference channel, a signal recognition method using deep learning is proposed. The signal demodulation is completed by identifying the signal. The deep confidence network uses a restricted Boltzmann machine as the basic unit to design a multi-layer deep confidence network for communication signal identification. The communication signal is first transformed into a specific characterization sequence, and a complete training set is constructed to perform layer-by-layer unsupervised learning and global supervised fine-tuning feedback learning for the deep confidence network, and realize communication in the weight parameter optimization process of the deep confidence network. Feature extraction and recognition of signals. Simulation experiments show that compared with the traditional modulation signal demodulation method, the detection performance of the signal demodulation method using deep learning is about 0.4 dB boost.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Family Service Robot Based on Neural Network PID Motion Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: For the fixed invariability of control parameters in the PID closed-loop control algorithm of existing mobile robot, and the poor real-time response and stability of robot chassis to the upper machine motion control command, a robot motion control system is designed based on BP neural network PID motion control algorithm. Firstly, according to the three-wheel omni-directional mobile robot motion characteristics and the principle of neural network PID control algorithm, the control system is modeled and simulated on simulink, it theoretically demonstrates that the BP neural network PID closed-loop control algorithm is superior to the traditional PID control algorithm. The simulation results show that the overshoot is small and the real-time performance is good, which can greatly improve the flexibility and stability of the system. Then, through the top-down design method by Verilog language, the FPGA design of BP neural network PID closed-loop control system is carried out. The three-wheel omni-directional mobile robot chassis is used as the experimental platform, which is controlled by the robot upper machine to follow and avoid obstacles. The test results show that the control system improves the robot's running speed by 11.6% and accuracy by 13.4%. Compared with the open-loop control system, which effectively verifies the feasibility and practicability of the closed-loop control system.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Knowledge Modelling of Power Grid Dispatching Regulations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In the integrated mode of power grid dispatching and control centralized monitoring, the dispatchers need to prioritize events, determine fault types and propose solutions timely and accurately, which puts forward the high requirements on the operational ability and the response level of the dispatchers. To relieve the working pressure of the dispatchers, a grid dispatching ontology knowledge base based on the ontology theory and the dispatching rules is built in this paper, which realizes information search and query with conciseness, preciseness, and rapidity. The instantiation of the power grid dispatching knowledge ontology can provide decision-making assistance, information query and verification, emergency handling and other functions.

articleTitle: Research on Pilot-Based Channel Estimation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The numerous advantages of massive MIMO technology make it one of the key technologies of 4G communication. However, with the increase of antennas, the channel matrix dimension is getting higher and higher, and the channel situation is more complicated, which puts forward higher requirements for channel estimation algorithm. In this paper, we have studied two pilot-based channel estimation algorithms: LS and MMES algorithm. We have applied these two channel estimation algorithms to OFDM systems and analyzed their results respectively. Our simulation results show that the performance of MMSE channel estimation is better than LS channel estimation, but its computational complexity is higher than LS channel estimation. So the LS channel estimation algorithm is always used under general industrial requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Voice Interaction Technology in VR Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has broad prospects and has a wide range of application fields. This paper studied the interactive combination of natural language processing technology and virtual reality environment in artificial intelligence, and optimized it in the software design level. This paper achieved VR and NLP environment based on unity3d engine. Finally, the input voice signal can be converted into interactive commands in VR environment, and VR environment also can be controlled by the voice.

articleTitle: A Novel Magnetic Induction Communication Transmitter Based on a Mechanical Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The rotating magnet based mechanical antenna (RMBMA) is introduced to realize ELF~VLF magnetic induction communication. The simulation results show that the induced magnetic field generated by the mechanical antenna has little attenuation in seawater and almost no reflection on the air-water interface. It is a promising energy-efficient technology to achieve a longer range magnetic induction communication.

articleTitle: Rapid Distinguish of Edible Oil Adulteration Using a Hyperspectral Spectroradiometer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The adulteration of edible oil is one of the widely existing oil quality problems. In this study, a hyperspectral spectroradiometer was utilised to discriminate sesame and rapeseed oil adulteration rapidly using soybean oil. The reflectance spectra of 350-2500 nm were obtained from different adulterated oil samples using the hyperspectral spectroradiometer. Support Vector Machine (SVM) and random forest (RF) were used for spectral analysis to classify adulteration types. And RF achieved an accuracy of 100%. Considering the redundant information of reflectance spectra, the optimal wavelengths were selected by Principal Component Analysis to increase processing speed and simplify the model for subsequent applications. With the spectra of eight selected wavelengths, the accuracy of SVM achieved 92.86%. These results indicated that a hyperspectral spectroradiometer can distinguish edible oil adulteration.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Optimization of Game UI Framework Based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The design of the UI framework is something that any game development has to do. It is almost the first thing a player sees when he opens a game. It is probably what the player doesn't care most about. For developers, almost every game module has a connection with the UI, and if it is not handled properly, the UI becomes a nightmare. For example, aspect ratio adaptation, resolution adaptation, pixel alignment. these are enough for inexperienced developers to waste a lot of time. Fortunately, engines like Unity provide already powerful UI solutions, as well as plugins from many other developers. But this is not enough. This article focuses on the design and optimization of UI frameworks.

articleTitle: High Precision Weight Measurement of Liquid Viscosity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: There are a variety of purpose measuring the weight with different readability and the capacity of the weighing system, such as the using in daily life, large weight measuring instrument or laboratory dedicated high-precision digital measuring instrument. This report introduces a kind of laboratory weighing apparatus, a high-precision instrument for measuring liquid viscosity. The target weighing system readability is very sensitive, at 0.1 mg, which requires every step of making this weighing device minimizes the error. Therefore, the measuring instrument needs to use high-precision sensor, 24-bit analogue to digital converter HX711, and Arduino Uno, which is a compact and lightweight Arduino series board, has the ability to store data and perform logical operations.

Author Keywords: high precision strain gauge load cell

articleTitle: The Development of a 2-20 GHz Limiter Integrated with Low Noise Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: A 2-20 GHz limiter low noise amplifier (LNA) based on 0.15 μm GaAs pHEMT technology is designed and fabricated. The limiter and LNA are integrated on same substrate. To achieve ultra-wideband performance, LNA is designed by cascaded common gate-common source and distributed topology. On-wafer measured results show that during working frequency, the proposed limiter LNA has yielded gain of 18±1 dB, noise figure (NF) of 1.6-3.2 dB and 1 dB compression point is above 14 dBm. The total power consumption is 350mW@5V. The limiter LNA can withstand 20 dBm pulse power (2ms, 30% duty cycle). The total size of chip is 4.8 × 2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Intelligent Terminal of Power Grid Based on Trusted Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and the rapid promotion of smart grid construction, more and more intelligent terminals are used in smart grids as a key equipment terminal. There are many advantages when intelligent terminals are introduced, such as more convenient and accurate when collecting data. However, the introduction of intelligent terminals also brings certain security problems to the smart grid. Attackers can more easily invade the smart grid through intelligent terminals and destroy the power supply. Therefore, it is of great significance to improve the security of intelligent terminals in power grids. Trusted Computing Technology is an information security solution that builds a secure and trusted computing environment. Based on the trusted computing technology, a new architecture of intelligent grid terminals is proposed in this paper. Combined with the actual needs of grid intelligent terminals, a new trusted startup model and integrity measurement model are constructed.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Evidence-Based Practice Evaluation of Mental Health in Psychological Platform under the Background of Internet + Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Under the current social development in China, the application of evidence-based practice evaluation in psychological health of psychological platform is very important, especially in the context of today's Internet + technology, the evaluation and application of psychological platform mental health evidence-based practice evaluation are faced. new challenge. The development of today's Internet + background is driving the operation of big data and providing effective data support for evidence-based practice evaluation. Based on the current Internet + technology background, this paper looks forward to the combination of Internet + technology and psychological platform evidence-based practice evaluation, and proposes the practical application method combining Internet + technology and mental platform mental health evidence-based practice evaluation. The effect analysis of the combination of Internet + technology and mental health evidence-based practice evaluation, this paper applies to the daily work of China's major psychological platforms, provides theoretical support for the evidence-based practice evaluation of major psychological platforms, to promote mental health evidence-based The maturity of practical evaluation techniques.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of ECC Point Multiplication Algorithm Over GF(2m)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) point multiplication algorithm, this paper presents a new high-efficient algorithm and architecture of ECC point multiplication. Firstly, we analyze and optimize the designs of the modular addition, the modular multiplication, the modular square and the modular inversion. Then, we propose an integral serial and partial parallel structure of point multiplication over GF(2m), and design the overall hardware circuit using 2 modular multiplication units. Over GF (2233), the experimental results using FPGA show that our approach can reduce time required for point multiplication to 5.87us, while the resource cost is kept a reasonable amount to 8682 slices.

articleTitle: The Design of Low Power Portable ECG Monitor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: As an important means of observing cardiac information, ECG monitoring is used to reflect the current changes of heart rate in real time, and is an important basis for judging cardiovascular diseases. For the current medical ECG monitoring equipment, there are some problems that the instrument is too large, the operation is complicated, and the real-time monitoring cannot perform for a long time. This paper uses BMD101 chip to design a portable ECG monitoring node with small size, low power consumption and long-term real-time monitoring. The implementation method includes two steps. First, we used two electrodes to collect bioelectrical signals from the human body. Then, the BMD101 chip will amplify, filter and A/D convert this signal, and then use the corresponding algorithm to get the heart rate of the human body.

articleTitle: Research on a Recycling Strategy of Old Objects Based on Internet + Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In today's society, the economy is developing at a rapid pace, the material is extremely rich, and the speed of upgrading of items has led to the idling and abandonment of many items. Correspondingly, the utilization rate of old materials is extremely low, and problems such as pollution and waste are urgently needed. China attaches great importance to environmental protection. The state not only designates it as a basic national policy, but also develops a series of laws and regulations on environmental protection in order to better implement this basic national policy. With the continuous development of China's economic development, green environmental protection concept, the continuous promotion of environmental protection policies and the continuous improvement of people's understanding, the ways and methods of environmental protection have gradually enriched, and the reuse of old materials is one of them. And green recycling projects are springing up like mushrooms. The waste materials that conform to the green design are diverse and extensive. The metals, plastics, and glass that are common in life are listed here. The way of recycling, processing, and reusing old materials has received extensive attention and recognition. At the same time, the Internet era has promoted the construction and development of an environment-friendly society, combined the Internet with the recycling of old materials, and proposed the promotion and methods of Internet-based recycling of old materials.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling Voice-Coil Motor Displacement Change Using an Electrical Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Voice coil motor (VCM) is a special type of direct current drive motor, which generates the force in the magnetic field by using the current coil. And the force is proportional to the current through the coil. In the smart phone camera module, the automatic focusing function of the mobile phone lens is realized by controlling the current of the voice coil motor. This paper presents a method of using the second-order effect of RLC circuit to achieve the unification of electrical and mechanical balance by means of voltage-controlled current source. The change of displacement of voice coil motor is equivalent to the change of capacitor voltage of RLC circuit, so that the change of displacement of VCM can be represented by the change of voltage of electrical components. The establishment of the equivalent model can realize the unification of VCM's displacement change with other electrical characteristics by circuit design, which is of great help to the study of displacement change and other performance of the system.

articleTitle: UAV Energy Utility Maximization Algorithm for Cellular UAV-to-Device Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a cellular unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) system where the collected sensory data can be transmitted to the base station (BS) by cellular communications, or to the mobile devices (MDs) directly by overlaying UAV-to-Device (U2D) communications. We optimize the UAV transmit power to maximize the energy utility (EU) of the UAVs, and we solve this problem by convex optimization and extremum principles. Simulation results show that our proposed algorithm can efficiently improve the EU performance of the system.

articleTitle: 5G Communication and Positioning Integrated System Based on Millimeter Wave
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: For the fifth generation mobile communication system (5G), millimeter wave is the inevitable choice of broadband communication. Because of the high attenuation in millimeter wave band, it is necessary to use beamforming convergent beams to increase transmission power, which can meet the transmission needs of mobile communications. At the same time, because of the high bandwidth, narrow beam and strong beam orientation of millimeter wave, in order to make the beam track the communication terminal in real time in the process of communication, it is necessary to use location information to realize real-time beam tracking. In this paper, the beamforming and communication positioning integration involved in millimeter-wave communication are analyzed and designed in detail, and the scheme is simulated by computer. The simulation results verify the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ultra-Low Delay Video Codec System Based on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the problems of high power consumption, poor performance and high delay of the existing video codec system, a real-time video coding and decoding system based on ZYNQ is proposed, and the hardware and software of the system are designed. The system test results show that the complex H.264 codec algorithm and UDP protocol stack are implemented in parallel by FPGA hardware and cooperate with ARM software, which can effectively reduce the delay of the system. Therefore, it has a good portability and wide application prospect.

articleTitle: A Registration Method for Augmented Reality System Based on Visual SLAM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In augmented reality, smart devices need to sense their own position in real physical space and complex scene structure to achieve good virtual reality interaction and three-dimensional registration. This paper proposes a technical framework of visual SLAM, which uses VO and BA methods based on feature points to obtain pose, and applies it to the augmented reality system to realize pose estimation, registration, tracking, collision and other effects of intelligent equipment independent of artificial or natural landmarks.

articleTitle: Pattern Design of Yi Nationality Lacquerware Based on Fractal Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: We can through the fractal design of Yi nationality's traditional pattern to create a new pattern with the characteristics of Yi nationality, explore a new way of innovative design of Yi nationality's traditional pattern lacquerware. Taking Ultra Fractal (UF) software as an example, after the fractal design of the basic pattern, the fractal design of the traditional pattern of Yi nationality lacquerware is carried out by using the Klein Transform algorithm provided by UF software, and a new pattern was generated through several iterations. By combining the traditional pattern with the new fractal art, this paper tries a new method of use fractal mathematical model to produce pattern and apply it to the decoration of lacquerware pattern.

articleTitle: An Image Recognition Algorithm Based on Self-Encoding and Convolutional Neural Network Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the advent of big data and the era of universal Internet, the powerful representation capability of convolutional neural networks in large-scale visual recognition is particularly important, but image recognition performance is limited by the influence of environmental noise. To this end, this paper proposes an image recognition algorithm based on self-encoding and convolutional neural network fusion. The noise reduction algorithm is used to reduce the noise of the input image, and then the trained convolutional neural network is used to identify the image. The noise reduction self-encoder not only makes the public training data set suitable for the actual environment, but also improves the usage rate of the training model, so that the model is decoupled from the specific environment. The experimental results show that the image recognition algorithm proposed in this paper can have a good recognition rate with/without ambient noise.

articleTitle: Architecture Design and Research Based on Distributed Configuration Center
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the development of business, there are more and more configurations in the application system. Different configurations are needed when the same program corresponds to different business. At the same time, more and more distributed applications are needed. By studying the specific requirements of configuration management in distributed environment, this paper presents a design scheme of a distributed configuration center, which is based on unified configuration management and provides gray configuration and rollback of historical configuration.

articleTitle: Multi-Projection Surface Deformation Control Method Based on Elevation Naturalization Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Aiming at the engineering characteristics of the plateau region, a multi-projection surface deformation control method based on elevation naturalization model is proposed. Firstly, the elevation naturalization model calculus and the elevation tolerance are determined. Then, according to the difference between the offset projection surface and the construction work section set by the project section, the construction lofting work is carried out; the projection surface setting in the elevation tolerance, the setting of the single transition projection surface, and the multiple transitions are specifically divided into the setting of the projection surface. The method can ensure the accuracy of the lofting measurement of the project with high efficiency, and can better control the elevation and deformation of the engineering.

articleTitle: Information Management Strategy of Teaching Management in the Age of Cloud Computing and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Cloud computing and big data further promote the development of various industries and fields, and truly realizes the concept of network information management. Based on this, the paper mainly analyzes the characteristics of higher vocational education teaching management, and in-depth analysis of the shortcomings of teaching management, from multiple levels of inquiry to develop a scientific and reasonable teaching management information strategy, in order to ensure the quality of higher vocational education teaching management.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Traffic Guidance in Smart City under the Environment of Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: with the development of social economy and the improvement of people's living standards, the capacity of the existing urban road network is difficult to meet the surging traffic demand, and the choice of traffic path affects the distribution of traffic flow in the road network to a large extent. In this paper, the key technology of urban traffic path guidance is studied by combining the Internet of vehicles technology, so as to provide real-time and efficient guidance information service for vehicles in the road network, realize the balanced distribution of traffic flow in the road network, and excavate the maximum capacity of the existing road network, so as to alleviate traffic congestion. This paper constructs the car networking framework under the condition of traffic information collection technology, and the traffic information in the network transmission of the minimum spacing, vehicle and roadside tree nodes are studied, and then in order to improve the accuracy of vehicle location information, for GPS by the interference of high buildings, parking lots, tunnels city, puts forward the RFID assisted GPS positioning technology, using RFID information to modify the positioning error of GPS. Finally, the ant movement rules and pheromone updating rules of the ant colony algorithm were improved, and a dynamic path re-search strategy was proposed. Finally, a simulation environment was established on Matlab. Based on the collected traffic information and short-term traffic flow prediction information, the ant colony algorithm was used to solve the problem and realize the traffic path induction.

articleTitle: Research on Controller Redundancy Strategy of Acupuncture Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of high reliability and safety of acupuncture robot control system, this paper studies the redundancy strategy for acupuncture robot. The hardware design strategy, heartbeat strategy, synchronization strategy and arbitration strategy of the redundant system are discussed in detail, and the effectiveness of the proposed redundancy strategy of acupuncture robot controller is verified by OMNeT++ distributed network simulation platform.

articleTitle: An All-to-All Broadcast Algorithm for Multi-Priority Packets in Ad Hoc Networks Using Directional Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: All-to-All broadcast is one of the most important communication tasks in directed Ad hoc network. Using multi-beam adaptive antennas, a centralized low-delay link scheduling algorithm (CLDA) is proposed for directional All-to-All broadcast with low-redundancy. The algorithm effectively reduces the redundant transmission and transmission delay in All-to-All broadcast by extracting the topology information and determining the priority. Moreover, it is verified through simulation that the algorithm can significantly reduce the All-to-All broadcast delay and transmission redundancy: in the random topology, the All-to-All broadcast delay is reduced by up to 59.6%, and the transmission redundancy is eliminated to 0%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a PM2.5 Dust Detection System Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: According to the requirement of air quality (dust) detection in classroom and laboratory, a dust concentration detection system is designed. The system is based on bidirectional wireless communication technology and uses single chip computer as processor. It collects the concentration of dust particles in the air and air temperature and humidity information using DSM501 sensor system. In this paper, a wireless sensor network for monitoring dust concentration and environmental temperature and humidity is established by Zigbee technology. The detected information is transmitted to the host computer through wireless network for analysis and statistics. The PM2.5 concentration, temperature and humidity in classroom or laboratory air are measured and displayed. The comparative experiment proves that the consistency of the instrument is not more than 25%.

articleTitle: Multi-View and Multi-Information Clustering for Semi-Supervised Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Deep learning based methods for person re-identification (re-id) have aroused extensive attention in recent years. However, most works adopt fully-supervised learning, which heavily rely on a large amount of labeled training data. And collecting labeled samples is quite time consuming. To address this problem, we present a semi-supervised framework for person re-id. The key point in this work is to estimate the label of unlabeled data, thus a multi-view and multi-information clustering (MVMIC) method is proposed. First, multi-view feature representation is obtained by two Convolutional Neural Networks, then KNN graphs can be constructed by the feature representation. Finally, multi-information is collected from the KNN graphs to select positive pairs and clustering will be achieving. Experimental results on two large-scale datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Non-Uniform Linear Array Beamforming Algorithm Based on High-Order Cumulant
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we first establish a model of a uniform linear array (ULA) antenna, and build an array model of the coprime array based on this, and then use the high-order cumulant to expand the array of linear constrained minimum variance (LCMV). Finally, through computer simulation, the reliability and effectiveness of the method are proved. In this paper, we export the signals received by the matrix array to the virtual domain, forming an equivalent uniform array of array element expansion on the virtual domain. Therefore, the number of array elements actually receiving signals is larger than the number of array elements of the coprime array. Increases the freedom of the system while reducing the cost of the antenna. Use high-order cumulant to expand the array, effectively reduce the width of the main lobe, suppress the sidelobe level, increase the depth of the null, and effectively suppress the Gaussian white noise due to the good mathematical properties of the high-order cumulant.

articleTitle: An Improved Wilkinson Power Divider and Its Applications in GaN MMIC Power Amplifier in W-Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: A high-power gallium-nitride (GaN) monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) operating over the 92-96GHz band is reported. Using an on-chip Multistage power synthesis power-combining network, according to the simulation results, it achieves a continuous wave output power level of 30 dBm (1 W) over the 92-96GHz bandwidth and the forward transfer function S21 achieves 11dB and the return loss achieves -20db. This paper also presents design details on the combining network.

articleTitle: Interference Graph-Based Resource Management for Vehicular Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The maturity of the Internet of vehicles (IoV) ecosystem enabled driverless vision and vehicle communication technology is the key link to realize vehicular network. In this paper, the interference in IoV is divided by graph theory, further partite V2V users into different clusters. Then, the highway scenario is modeled, the closed expression of the best allocation power of vehicle unit is deduced. Based on this, the influence of vehicle speed, V2V interrupt threshold and other parameters on the vehicular communication is analyzed. Simulation results show that graph-based clustering is beneficial to reduce the interference between V2I/V2V and improve the total throughput of V2I link.

articleTitle: Relay Protection Data Integrity Check Method Based on Big Data Association Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Relay protection big data creates good conditions for the improvement of professional applications, and data integrity is an important aspect that reflects data quality. The association of relay protection big data is intense. This paper applies Apriori algorithm to mine data relevance and generate association rules. Based on this, the integrity of relay protection data is checked, and the incomplete data is predicted. Taking the relay protection defect data as an example, the paper explores the correlation among 251 items of the six dimensions of protection relay defect data such as type of protection, the severity of the defect, whether the protection is out of operation, the defect location, the cause of the defect, and the equipment manufacturer, completing the processing of incomplete data with great application results.

articleTitle: Design of Electronic Cigarette System Based on Ultrasonic Atomization Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Ultrasonic atomized e-cigarette disperses the molecular bond force of liquid droplets by using ultrasonic high-frequency resonance of atomizer in order to atomize E-liquid. In this paper, we propose a new design of electronic cigarette system based on ultrasonic atomization technology. At first, we improve the design of electronic cigarette circuit system based on ultrasonic atomization technology; then, we analyze the preparation and composition of e-cigarette oil; in the end, we test the atomization effect of the new e-cigarette system and compare it with a traditional kind of electronic cigarette. According to the result, ultrasonic technology is not only technically feasible but also effective in atomizing electronic E-liquid.

articleTitle: Analysis of AdaBoost-Based Face Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: AdaBoost-based face detection algorithm plays a crucial role in the field of face detection, which is based on the optimization of boosting. And its advantage is that it can determine the sample weight in the next training according to the previous sample training results. In such an algorithm, the leading research focuses on the Haar-like feature, and the algorithm is also closely related to the fundamental diagram. By extracting the portrait features using Haar-like features, calculating the eigenvalues using the Integral Image, and filtering out the weak classifier and strong classifier through the weighted voting method, the algorithm ideally improves the detection speed and accuracy of the classifier. Therefore, it has several excellent advantages, including a lower rate of generalization errors, no need for parameter adjustment, and higher stability.

articleTitle: Research on Improving SMOTE Algorithms for Unbalanced Data Set Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the classification effect of unbalanced data sets is not ideal, a new method of improving SMOTE algorithm, TDSMOTE algorithm, is proposed in this paper. A small number of samples are divided into three regions, dense region, boundary region and sparse region. Different sampling methods are used for samples from different regions. Finally, random forest algorithm is used to classify the samples. Experiments were carried out on six UCI unbalanced datasets and compared with traditional algorithms. Experiments show that the TDSMOTE algorithm achieves higher G-means, F-value and AUC values, and effectively improves the classification performance of unbalanced data sets.

articleTitle: Research on Compressed Sensing DOA Estimation Based on Priori Space Sparsity of Information Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Using spatial sparsity of array signal, compressed sensing technology can be used to model DOA estimation. The matching pursuit algorithm of classical greedy orthogonal is used to solve the problem. However, this algorithm must take spatial sparsity of signal that the number of sources of spatial array signal as a prior condition to accurately estimate multiple DOAs. The AIC and MDL criteria based on information theory are adopted to estimate the spatial sparsity in this paper, and spatial sparse distribution of equal sinusoid is used. Finally better MDL criteria and greedy orthogonal matching pursuit algorithm are combined to solve the problem. The simulation results show that the better performance of direction estimation can be obtained under multiple snapshot data model.

articleTitle: Continuous Measurement of Distributed Vibration Using Coherent Rayleigh Backscattering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The detection of external vibration with optical pulses is the discrete sampling in phase-sensitive OTDR. In this paper, the continuous measurement of distributed vibration based on the phase-sensitive OTDR is demonstrated. The synchronized optical signal consisting of narrow optical pulses and the background light is injected into the sensing fiber as probe light. The time-resolved disturbance is continuously recorded by the background optical signal. The detectable frequency response range and the accuracy of the signal reconstruction are improved. The Rayleigh backscattering light generated by the background optical signal interferes at the detection end, presenting an enhanced sensitivity to external vibrations. The Rayleigh backscattering of narrow pulses is tracked to locate vibrations. The system can realize continuous measurement of distributed vibration with enhanced frequency response range and sensitivity.

articleTitle: Ultra Wideband Bandpass Filter with Sharp Selectivity Using Interdigitated Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband (UWB) bandpass filter (BPF) is proposed, which is formed by an interdigitated structure and a defected ground structures (DGS) and four short-circuited branches. This filter has sharp selectivity due to two zeros at low frequencies. One of the two low-frequency zeros of the filter is at 1.2 GHz and the other is at 3.8 GHz. The proposed filter has a working frequency range of 3.85 GHz to 11.83 GHz and the center frequency is 7.89 GHz. The filter was designed using a RT/Duroid 5870 medium with a thickness of 0.862 mm. The total fractional bandwidth is 101%.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Efficiency Optimization of Indoor Network for Green Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to achieve green communication, this paper studied the energy efficiency optimization of indoor network based on the transmit power of home base stations. Firstly, a three-dimensional system model of dense deployment of home base stations is established, in which the physical location of the home base stations follows the Poisson Point Process (PPP). Secondly, a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed to optimize the transmit power of the home base stations to improve the energy efficiency of the system. In addition, this paper compared deep reinforcement learning algorithm with Q learning algorithm and random allocation algorithm. Finally, the simulation results showed that our proposed algorithm has a fast convergence rate and is superior to the other two algorithms in energy efficiency optimization.

articleTitle: The Management Scheme of Embedded Memory Based on Power Grid System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In the modern smart grid system, power network and communication network are integrated, which make the security situation more and more complex. The diversification of network terminal service data makes higher requirements on real-time performance and security. As an important node for data storage and processing, the security of embedded terminal memory management becomes the inevitable requirement of smart grid terminal. Traditional embedded memory management methods have some problems, such as low security and low space efficiency. In this paper, a memory management scheme based on secure compilation options and address space randomization technology is put forward. By comparing with other traditional memory management schemes, it is concluded that the scheme has better timeliness, security, reliability and less space overhead.

articleTitle: Performance Prediction of Network-Intensive Systems in Cloud Environment: A Bayesian Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The resource requirements of cloud applications varies with the load intensity, so it is necessary to predict resource changes in advance. In this paper, a Bayesian method is proposed to predict the bandwidth consumption and quality of service. First, log mining is used to extract feature variables, and a Bayesian model is constructed by using stepwise discriminant method to select characteristic variables that are crucial for prediction. Then Bayesian discriminant and Bayesian network are used to predict the bandwidth consumption and response time. At last, we use a real-running web system to evaluate the effectiveness and accuracy of this method. Comparing with other methods, it can get more accurate prediction result of the performance in the cloud environment.

articleTitle: Imaging for Bistatic Airborne Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave SAR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Frequency modulated continuous wave synthetic aperture radar (FMCW SAR) has become one of the main SAR research directions for its small size, light weight and high resolution, which is suitable for air-borne or UAV-borne SAR imaging. In this paper, a FMCW SAR structure is proposed, the transmitter and receiver are placed at the same flying path, separated with a constant distance to attain good isolation. The simulation result is presented for SAR imaging.

articleTitle: Simulation of Shielding Effectiveness with Different Interference Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The external electromagnetic environment around the helicopter has profound influence on the combat performance. The helicopter's skin structure is the main approach to electromagnetic shielding. This paper has mainly simulated the electromagnetic field distribution in the cabin after the external electromagnetic environment passes through the helicopter's skin structure with different radiation directions or polarization modes. Then this paper draws a conclusion from the simulation about the influence of radiation direction and polarization mode on shielding effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Wearable System for the Elderly Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the aging problem, the health and safety of the elderly has aroused widespread concern in society. With the rapid development of the Internet of Things, wearable medical devices are also becoming a research focus. On this basis, this paper designs the system terminal and related functional modules and proposes a complete software architecture. It is of great social significance to design a smart wearable device and monitoring platform based on the monitoring of the elderly.

articleTitle: Construction and Simulation of Competition and Cooperation Model of Logistics Park Enterprises Based on Immune Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In the limited rational decision-making activities of enterprises, there are both competition and cooperation among all kinds of enterprises in the logistics park. Based on the theory of co-evolution, using the principle of biological immunity and combining with logistic model, this paper constructs a co-competition and co-evolution model of logistics park enterprises based on immune mechanism. The simulation model is established by using the Matlab simulation platform, and the model is run under the conditions of competing parameters of different enterprises. It shows the change mechanism of population density in the process of competitive and cooperative co-evolution, and provides a reference theoretical basis for enterprises in logistics parks to formulate effective competitive and cooperative strategies. Besides, the application of immune theory in the construction of enterprise competitive and cooperative co-evolution model, provides a new perspective and method for the study of cooperative and cooperative co-evolution behavior of enterprises in logistics parks.

articleTitle: A New Probe into the Security Problems and Prevention Strategies of Computer Network Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Analysis of the current status of computer network communication security at this stage can be seen that it is affected by many factors, which leads to more problems in this work, which is not conducive to people's normal life, production and other activities. It also leads frequent information leakage problems, making the privacy is not guaranteed, threatening people to use the computer network to carry out the security and effectiveness of activities. Therefore, in this case, the technical department concerned with ensuring the security of computer network communication needs to be deeply researched and analyzed for the emerging security problems. The prevention strategy significantly improves the security of the computer network and effectively protects the user's information security. Based on this paper, the current computer network communication security issues are summarized. Several problems are proposed to help solve the problem. It is hoped that it can provide benefits for the subsequent improvement on computer network communication security in China.

articleTitle: A Practical Transient Stability Margin Algorithm Based on Information-Driven and Fine Fault Information
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: At present, the transient stability control adopts the uniform cutting stability control measure and asymmetric faults are treated with three-phase short circuit, called event-driven analysis, which ensures the reliability of the system stability, but the accuracy is not enough. Taking three-phase short circuit as a benchmark, this paper analyzes the relationship of limit cutting time between the three-phase short circuit and various asymmetric faults in different fault positions, presents the angle-time curve of four kinds of short-circuit faults with a unified expression and obtains the limit cutting time directly according to the limit cutting angle, which turns event-driven into information -driven. The single-machine infinite bus model is built in matlab and the analysis of asymmetric faults is verified. It is found that the maximum difference of limit cutting time between asymmetric faults and three-phase short circuit is 500ms. Therefore, it is of great significance to obtain the accurate limit cutting time of asymmetric faults.

articleTitle: Phase Tracking Algorithm of IEEE 802.15.4g MR-OFDM with Frequency Offset
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: IEEE 802.15.4g Standard specifies multi-rate and multi-regional orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MR-OFDM) physical layer, which supports principally outdoor, low-data-rate, wireless, smart metering utility network (SUN). The inter-channel interference (ICI) results in subcarrier frequency sampling offset and phase shift for signal on MR-OFDM. In this paper, phase tracking algorithms which estimate and compensate the offset on symbols are studied. A basic phase tracking method is presented that the phase rotation of reception signal can be recognized by using the data on the pilot tones. Furthermore, in order to mitigation the influence of noise, an average-based algorithm is proposed as a modified solution. In contrast with the basic method, the average-based algorithm enhances the reliability of phase tracking. Simulations of algorithms are assessed, which are in accordance with theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Extraction of Ontological Terminology Relations of Scheduling Regulations Based on Combination Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The standardization of domain knowledge and knowledge sharing can be realized easily based on ontology technology. However, It takes time and effort to build ontology manually. In the semi-automatic ontology construction based on ontology learning, the extraction method of term relations has shortcomings such as poor portability and low accuracy. To improve the performance of ontology term relation extraction, a new method of ontology term relation extraction is proposed in this paper, and the experimental results are provided.

articleTitle: Indoor Positioning System Based on Micro-Inertial Navigation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an indoor positioning system by studying micro-inertial navigation technology and Pedestrien Dead Reckoning. In the complex fire environment, the system can collect the three-dimensional motion trajectory of firefighters in real time, realizing indoor three-dimensional positioning without blind zone and monitoring of personnel movement state. The system can improve the rescue capability of the fire department. Through different scene tests, the positioning accuracy of the system is high and the precise positioning time is long.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Evidential C-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper aims to propose a Multi-objective approach to Evolutionary Evidential C-Mean (MOE2CM) clustering method with underlying evolution strategy called NSGA-II. Two objective functions that respectively control the compactness and separation of a creedal partition are simultaneously optimized. The resultant set contains a number of non-dominated solutions, which the decision maker can pick up the most promising one according to the problem requirements. Results demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed technique are provided for a numeric and a real world dataset.

articleTitle: The Effective Method to Elicit Requirements of Scientific Research
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: How to acquire correct and sufficient requirements at the beginning of project approval is an important factor for a successful project. By explaining the common problems in the process of requirement acquisition, analyzing the causes of requirement defects, and further analyzing the significance of requirements of scientific research projects, especially of the software development projects, this paper finally puts forward the method of deep requirement mining, which provides effective reference and guidance for requirement mining in scientific research projects.

articleTitle: Traceability of Power Quality Pollution in Smelting Industry Event Traceability Based on Steady State Characteristic Index
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper describes a public access point which is connected with several smelting enterprise, occurred serious power quality violation phenomenon, which needs to install the corresponding compensation device for treatment, after a preliminary estimate needs to invest 0.45 million yuan (RMB). There are several industries in the 10kV line, which are using different kinds of melting furnaces. Testing of the public access and the melting equipment are applicated, and analyzing the indexes which are exceeding the standard is also applicated. After summarizing all the power quality indexes that exceed the standard, the paper analysis the influence of power quality pollution caused by different types of smelting furnaces, and classifies the power quality indexes and effects of different smelting furnaces used by different enterprises on the line. Finally, the power quality operation indexes of smelting furnaces used by all enterprises on the line were classified, and finally the sources of smelting furnaces with the most serious influence were determined. At the same time, the sources of equipment with different over-standard problems were confirmed, and the traceability analysis of power quality pollution sources was realized. Thus, the type of local compensation device and compensation capacity required by the production equipment of the enterprise are determined. After re-estimation, capital investment of 0.13 million yuan is required to save power quality management capital of 0.32 million yuan for the industry.

articleTitle: Simulation and Design of Dielectric Embedded Dual-Beam Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: A millimeter-band dielectric embedded dual-beam antenna is designed and simulated, which is based on microstrip antenna theory, the Yagi antenna principle and the design method of dielectric embedded microstrip antenna. The antenna buries improved planar printed microstrip Yagi antenna in the dielectric to form a dielectric embedded antenna. The director element of traditional Yagi antenna is changed from one to two, which is used to constrain the beam direction and increase the gain. By using an additional parasitic patch to improve the antenna, a larger relative impedance bandwidth is obtained, and the relative bandwidth is increased from 6.87% to 7.62%, and the gain is 9.96dB, which can be applied to short-distance communication and has good application value.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Emergency Rescue Command System Based on UWB Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Ultra-wideband (UWB) technology has the advantages of low complexity, good spatio-temporal characteristics and strong penetrability, which can meet the precise positioning and vital sign detection functions of the emergency rescue command system. The system also realizes the real-time transmission of audio and video data by using the self-organizing network and the RTP protocol, providing a basis for effective command and dispatch of the emergency rescue site, and improving the quality and efficiency of the emergency rescue. After repeated experiment, optimization and improvement by testers, the system can meet the on-site command requirements of multiple types of emergency rescue, ensure the safety of rescuers, reach the international leading level in the industry, and has the value of promotion and use.

articleTitle: Transient Current and Dispersion Characteristics of Transmission Lines Subjected to Lightning Stroke at Different Locations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to study the lightning current diversion and potential distribution and diversion characteristics of grounding devices in different locations of transmission lines subjected to lightning strikes, a complete model of transmission line poles, towers and grounding devices is established, and the voltage and current on poles and towers and grounding devices subjected to lightning strikes under three different lightning strikes, namely lightning arresters, shielding wires and lightning strikes on the top of poles and towers, and lightning strikes on lines are analysed. The influence of different locations on the distribution of ground potential and the distribution of current density. The calculation results show that lightning strikes on conductors have the greatest impact on the safe operation of transmission lines. The voltage on the grounding device is the highest when lightning strikes the tower top. The decreasing rate of ground potential and current density decreases gradually with the distance from the lightning current injection point. The research results can provide references for the optimization design of transmission line tower grounding body and the reduction of impulse grounding resistance. When the field test is difficult to carry out, the research method selected in this paper can be used as an alternative analysis.

articleTitle: Signed Mixed Domination Number of Circulant Graphs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we present some bounds on the signed mixed domination number of circulant graphs C (n; {1, k}) (k=2,3,4,5). We construct some signed mixed dominating functions, and upon these functions, we get some upper bounds of (γ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>*(C(n;{1,k})) which are very close to its lower bounds.

articleTitle: The Informatization Development of Wisdom Library under the Background of Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The construction of a smart library requires the support of a high-quality, diversified, and efficient information resource system. The necessity of the intelligent library information resource system architecture was discussed in terms of fully utilizing the discovery service system for the deep disclosure, management, and evaluation of collection resources, shared resources, and open access resources.

articleTitle: Optimization of Ship Target Detection Algorithm Based on Random Forest and Regional Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Target detection can assist in detecting the position of the target ship, which is an important part of the intelligent ship visual aid system. With the development and perfection of deep learning, the convolutional neural network technology has been continuously optimized. And it can automatically learn and extract features of objects in images, providing stronger distinguishing power and representation ability. In this paper, various optimization algorithms of convolutional neural networks are compared. Aiming at the problem of unbalanced ship targets in remote sensing images of near-port areas, a ship target detection algorithm based on random forest and Faster-RCNN is proposed. The random forest algorithm is used for model optimization due to its insensitivity to multi-collinearity. The positive effect of the optimized algorithm on accuracy is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Modeling of Tractor Routing Problem Considering the Departure Times of Trains in Euro-China Expressway
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In the Euro-China Expressway, strengthening the connection between highway and railway becomes an important method to improve the efficiency of the transport system. In this paper, we focus on the container assembly part in the highway echelon. We propose an optimization model for the tractor routing problem considering the departure time of trains. As a multimodal routing optimization problem, this problem has characteristics of long distance railway, multiple time windows and a variable quantity of tractors. We generate a series of instances to test the feasibility of the model. Instances are solved by mathematical approach. The result develops instructive conclusions.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Learning Rate on Face Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: As an important hyperparameter in facial expression recognition, learning rate determines whether the facial expression recognition function can converge to the local minimum and when it converges to the minimum value. With the increasing complexity of the facial expression recognition network model, it is particularly difficult to find a suitable learning rate, because the size of different parameters varies greatly and needs to be adjusted throughout the training process, which not only consumes a lot of time. Sometimes, it is not possible to adjust to the optimal, which makes it difficult to improve the accuracy of facial expression recognition. Therefore, in this paper, through the research and analysis of the facial expression recognition rate, we propose face expression recognition based on the Adabound algorithm and compare it with SGD (Stochastic Gradient Descent) and Adam on the face expression recognition network model use CK+ (Cohn-Kanade) dataset. The Adabound adaptive optimization algorithm achieved high accuracy of 96.97% and 100% on ResNet18 and ResNet34 respectively. Compared with recent articles, our model based on the Adabound algorithm has reached a very high level in the CK+ dataset in terms of the effect of a single model.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Preamble Detection of LoRa System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: LoRa (Long Range) technology is a long-distance, low-power wireless transmission technology based on Chirp (linear frequency modulation) technology, which has been widely regarded as the most mature low-power IOT (Internet of things) standard at present. The statistical characteristics of preamble symbol of LoRa system under AWGN channel were analyzed in this paper. When the preamble symbol detection algorithm with various SF (spreading factor), accumulative length, the number of output and detection times was used, the results of detection probability, false detection probability and missed detection probability were derived under a sort of signal-to-noise ratio and detection threshold. The simulation results were consistent with the theoretical analysis. It provides a theoretical basis for analyzing the synchronization and networking performance of LoRa system.

articleTitle: The Analysis on Under-Damped Response for Short-Circuit Fault of Electric Vehicle Charging Facility
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The short-circuit fault of electric vehicle charging facility based on the DC distribution network and energy router will lead a R-L-C resonant under-damped response. The theoretical deduction on R-L-C resonant under-damped response about fault voltage and current is made to analyze the effects of key influence factors and relevant system parameters.
