The simulation verified the validity of fault characteristics on resonant under-damped short-circuit current and capacitor voltage, which also indicated the relationship between fault characteristics and basic parameters of energy router employed in electric vehicle charging facility.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Opportunistic Spectrum Access Algorithm Based on Packet Length of Secondary User Service Request
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: As to the unslotted primary user network, opportunistic spectrum access for a single secondary user under periodic sensing framework was analyzed. By constructing the secondary user channel sense and access model, we proposed an opportunistic spectrum access algorithm based on packet length of secondary user service request. The proposed algorithm could automatically modify the strategy of opportunistic spectrum access according to the service data packet length allocated by each slot. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can enhance the secondary users expect effective throughput under the condition of tight interference, and realize the tradeoff between effective throughput and collision probability, as well as possessing the robustness if exotic environment changes.

articleTitle: Multi-Order Feature Fusion Joint Training Network for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN) has shown great powerful feature representation for remote sensing scene classification. Nevertheless, the current state-of-the-art related works only focus on the first-order deep feature statistics (i.e., convolutional layer, fully connected layer), does not consider high-order feature or feature fusion for achieving the discriminative feature representation. To tackle this problem, the multi-order feature fusion joint-training network (MFJN) is presented for remote sensing scene classification. Firstly, the second-order orderless feature statistics is obtained by the parameterized vector of locally aggregated descriptors (VLAD) layer which is embedded into the CNN. Secondly, the deep feature representation of the last convolutional layer is used as the first-order feature statistics, then the convolutional layer of size is used for dimensionality reduction. Finally, multi-order feature statistics is obtained by fusing the first and second-order feature statistics, then the normalization layer is employed in the MFJN. We applied MFJN on the Aerial Image data set (AID) for scene classification, experimental results show better performances than other related works.

articleTitle: Research on Influence of Temperature Effect on Silicon-on-Sapphire Pressure Sensor by Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper systemically introduced the effect of temperature on the measuring precision for silicon-on-sapphire pressure sensor using the inner stress distribution change as the main thread of analyzing method. Firstly, using the so called Fourier's 1st law and first law of thermodynamics, the temperature distribution of sapphire diaphragm is analyzed under the function of heat conduction and heat convection in which the temperature load is applied on the titanium alloy. Then, using the 4MPa as the pressure load, the stress distribution of under the function of pressure and the function of pressure and temperature are also analyzed. It is concluded that when the applied temperature is room temperature, temperature will initiate little effect to the inner stress. Their relative error is just 1.49%. When the analyzed temperature is 200°C, the relative error is 22%, which means the temperature has great effect to the measuring precision of the sensor.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Management in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the economic globalization, the international communication is more and more close, the international division of labor is more and more obvious, enterprises also from the past monopoly competition to win-win cooperation. In this era of big data, enterprises are faced with new opportunities and challenges. Data has become a symbol to measure all values, and the description and prediction of human society are more and more accurate. Meanwhile, supply chain management relies on data flow to optimize and integrate enterprise resources.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv3 Algorithm for Airport Detection under Complex Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Airport target detection in optical remote sensing images is a hot topic in image processing and machine vision in recent years. In this paper, an improved YOLOv3 target detection algorithm is proposed for the problem that the traditional target detection method is insufficient for airport detection under complex conditions. Firstly, the remote sensing image data set of complex background, multi-scale target, multi-objective, multi-category and different perspectives are constructed independently, which lays a foundation for the training of the model. Then the YOLv3 algorithm is improved for the target characteristics in the data set, so that The model can extract more deep-separated features of the target and play a better training effect. Finally, the effectiveness and significance of the algorithm are verified by comparison with other algorithms. The results show that the algorithm can achieve Real-time detection and gets a high detection rate.

articleTitle: The Influence of Interrupted Position on Sequential Human-Computer Interaction Tasks - Combination of Behavior Data Analysis and EEG Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Different interruption positions and complexity of interruption tasks has different effects on the performance and mental workload of users in sequential main tasks. This paper designed the human-computer interaction experiment under the interruptionsituations with different interruption positions and different complexity, combined the EEG equipment to measure the changes of the user's mental workload when the task was interrupted, and analyzed the effects of the interruption positions and the complexity ofinterruption tasks on the operational performance and mental workload, as well as its internal mechanism. The results showed that the interruption near the middle position led to significant increases in the error rate, resumption lag time and mental workload; complex interruption tasks resulted in an increase in the sequence error rate and an increase in mental workload. Research showed that the interruption had a negative effect on the performance of sequential main tasks, and also brought about changes in mental workload, which has a certain guiding significance for the design of human-computer interaction interrupt interface and the improvement of interruption management ability.

articleTitle: The Guiding Role of Scientific and Technological Methodology in the Development of Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The methodology of science and technology provides mankind with a correct way to understand and transform the world. Taking the process development and research application of quartz resonator cluster as an example, this paper further analyses the relationship between the methodology of science and technology and sensor technology development, and expounds the guiding and catalytic role of the methodology in the rapid development of natural science.

Author Keywords: the Methodology of Science and Technology

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Estimation for Intermittent Time-Varying Faults in Non-Gaussian Stochastic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper studies an improved adaptive fault estimation for the non-Gaussian stochastic systems with intermittent time-varying actuator faults. Type II fuzzy theory approximates the nonlinear dynamical systems with non-Gaussian stochastic outputs, disturbance and singular matrices under the harsh environments. An estimation observer with fuzzy and bionic adaptive laws is proposed to accurately estimate the different amplitudes of actuator faults. Where the bionic variable parameter algorithm that mimics animal predation behavior improves the sensitivity of observer to the incipient intermittent faults. Lyapunov function and linear matrix inequality prove the robust stability, and simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the methods.

articleTitle: A Fast Method for Measuring the Scattering Parameters of Microwave Two-Port Reciprocal Device Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: A Fast method for measuring the scattering parameters of microwave two-port reciprocal devices is presented in this paper. The method solves the problem of inconsistency between the port of device under test (DUT) and the interface of the vector network analyzer (VNA) by cascading two reciprocal transitions on the two ports of DUT. According to the cascading characteristics of the microwave network, the scattering parameters of the transition and DUT are obtained sequentially by using MATLAB program.

articleTitle: Research on Reverberation Signal under Ice Based on Physical Acoustic Modeling and Its Related Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Ocean reverberation is an important factor to affect the detection performance of active sonar, especially, in ice-covered sea areas. Because the interaction between ice and water will produce strong reverberation field, which have a great impact on the acoustic detection and communication performance. Physical acoustic method is firstly used to study the reverberation characteristics under the rough ice surface in this paper. Based on Kichhoff approximation, a Helmholtz scattering model is established under rough ice surface, and obtain the reverberation signal under ice, and analyzed its statistical and related characteristics. In order to simulate the ice surface which is in a fluctuating state, the stochastic process description method is used to describe the random fluctuating rough surface According to the reflection theory of ice-water interface, obtaining the relationship between the reflection coefficient of ice-water interface element and the incident angle function. The Hotz integral acoustic scattering model is used to obtains the reverberation signal under ice and analyze its correlation characteristics. At the same time, the correlation characteristics of the reverberation signal under ice is analyzed by analyzing the test data in Songhua River. The analyzed results show that the time correlation radius decreases and the correlation decreases with the increase of the signal frequency, and the spatial correlation coefficient shows oscillation attenuation relationship with the increase of the array spacing.

articleTitle: An Association Rule Mining Algorithm for Gas Monitoring Database
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: A new association rule mining algorithm is studied, which is based on gas monitoring database. In order to calculate itemsets support, this paper puts forward the concept of database characteristic matrix and characteristic vector, and leads to algorithm for mining association rules based on the characteristic matrix. This algorithm needs to traverse the database one time only, and the database operation has been reduced. Based on the characteristic vector inner product to get an Item set support, the efficiency of the algorithm has been improved. It improves the efficiency of association rules mining in mass gas databases.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Model Construction Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Deep learning is a process in which the learner studies new knowledge critically based on the existing knowledge and integrate existing knowledge with new knowledge to achieve deep understanding. Deep learning reflects the concept of active learning, collaborative learning and inquiry learning. As a new simulation technology, VR technology has such characteristics as immersion, interactivity and imagination, which provides learners experience, emotion and situational support for deep learning. Therefore, learners immerse themselves in the virtual reality space created by VR technology and explore new knowledge independently. Based on the support of VR technology for deep learning, this paper explored the elements of VR - based deep learning model, basic model construction method and design of deep learning route, which would offer model reference for institutions and personnel engaged in the field of deep learning.

articleTitle: An Improved Rotation Invariant CNN-Based Detector with Rotatable Bounding Boxes for Aerial Image Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Methods based on Convolutional neural network (CNN) have been effectively applied to object detection. However, the Traditional object detection models face huge obstacles in the field of the aerial scene due to the complexity of the aerial image and the wide degree of freedom of the remote sensing object in density, scale, and orientation. In this article, we applied rotatable bounding boxes (RBox) instead of the traditional bounding box (BBox) and improved the CNN-based network to effectively handle the oriented angle of the detected object so that the rotation invariant property can be achieved. Our model is trained and tested on 3 classes of remote sensing category Airplanes, ships, and Cars. Compared with two of the common benchmarks of the BBox methods Faster R-CNN and SDD, our model outperforms both of them. Where our model efficiently output the orientation angles of the detected objects.

articleTitle: A 5-D Chaotic System Based on Second-Order RCL Memristor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: A circuit model of memristor is designed using diodes, resistors, capacitors and inductors. Then, we proposed a five-dimensional memristor chaotic circuit model with the new model. Firstly, the fourth-order Runge-Kutta algorithm is used to solve the system numerically, and the stability of the system is analyzed. It is found that the system has only one equilibrium point, which is a saddle point. Secondly, the dynamic analysis of the system is carried out, and the Lyapunov exponent and bifurcation diagram varying with system parameters are drawn. The system is realized by a real circuit and the results are found to be in agreement with the numerical results by an oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Research on the External Detection Technology for Buried Steel Pipelines Based on Multi-Frequency Electromagnetic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to realize the non-excavation continuous detection of metal loss defects of buried steel pipelines without internal testing conditions, a research was conducted about the the external detection technology for buried steel pipelines based on multi-frequency electromagnetic by the theoretical analysis and the ansys finite element simulation. This paper was mainly about the the influence of pipeline metal loss defects on the multi-frequency alternating current passing through the pipeline and the influence of pipeline metal loss defects on the different frequency magnetic fields around the pipeline, which laid the foundation for the development of multi-frequency electromagnetic-based buried steel pipeline metal loss defect detection equipment and pipeline defect identification. The results showed that the pipeline metal loss defects played a great influence on the direction and magnitude of the flowing current. When the metal loss defect existed in pipeline, the magnetic field signals around the pipeline were abnormal. There was a significant difference between the magnetic field changes caused by the inner wall defect and the outer wall defect. Therefore, it was possible to determine whether the pipeline was defective by analyzing the variation law of the magnetic field around the pipeline and to determine whether the defect was located on the inner wall or the outer wall of the pipeline.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Design of Children's Module Toys
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: As a well-loved toy, "Modular Toys" is highly regarded by experts and scholars for its entertainment and puzzle functions. The new modular toys incorporate the "wisdom" element, giving the modular toys a broader meaning. It is a new means to help children understand the complex systems, the technology products of the information age, and help children learn and understand the real world and the virtual world. This paper proposes design suggestions for the intelligent development direction of children's modular toys by discussing the components of modular toys, the characteristics of intelligent modular toys, the value of modular toys for children's development, and the toy game method.

articleTitle: Study on a New Type MMC Hybrid Double Sub-Module Topology and Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: To solve the problem of the DC fault in the modular multilevel converter (MMC), a new topology of self-blocking sub-module is proposed in the paper-hybrid double sub-module (HDSM), which results in lower cost with the capacity of blocking the DC fault current, comparing with the full bridge sub-module. Comparing with clamp double sub-module, it can meet the reactive power requirement of the AC system without blocking action during the fault ride-through period. Besides, a voltage balancing strategy for the MMC based on the HDSM is proposed to keep the voltage of the sub-module balancing. Finally, simulation results show that the novel topology of sub-modules are valid and feasible.

articleTitle: High-Speed Image Processing Platform Based on UPP Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of processing the video data of PAL format of double signpost clearing [1], in order to have higher real-time and stability, a new high-speed video stream image processing platform is built. The platform uses the hardware of FPGA [2-3] to collect and output two-way video data, and carries out image processing operation with DSP. Data stream storage and buffering uses ping-pong technology to enable DSP to real-ize pipeline operation [4-5], which greatly enhances the real-time performance of the platform. In order to realize data interaction between FPGA and DSP, a handshake protocol is added for UPP to ensure data integrity and system stability. The image interleaving processing is implemented by the DSP internal pe-ripheral EDMA3[6-7], which saves the computing time of the DSP core for data handling and disassembly, and enriches the pro-cessing flow of image data. The experiments results show that the platform can achieve image recognition and image tracking algorithms, output expected video stream data, and the plat-form is stable and efficient, and has expansibility and diversity.

articleTitle: On the Vertex-Distinguishing Equitable Edge Coloring of Product Graph
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we derive two theorems of vertex-distinguishing equitable edge coloring of product graph by using constructive method, and present the vertex-distinguishing equitable edge chromatic numbers, which the required minimum number of colors is called the vertex-Distinguishing equitable edge chromatic number of product graphs between complete graph and complete graph, star and star, wheel and wheel, which verify the conjecture on VDEECC.

articleTitle: Locally Modified Laplacian Feature Mapping
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In the age of big data, the amount of data is getting larger, and the complexity of data is getting higher. Manifold learning is designed to clean the data, eliminate the noise information, and extract the effective features of the data. Traditional manifold learning still has some shortcomings in terms of manifold assumptions and the complexity of algorithm design. This paper aims to design a new manifold learning algorithm designed to make up for the shortcomings of traditional algorithms. Here we mainly improved the algorithm LEM and proposed an improved algorithm LEM, referred to as MLEM. In the aspect of experiment, we introduced three groups of integrated datasets. The experimental results show that the algorithm MLEM is superior to the traditional manifold learning algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel High Precision Range and Velocity Measuring Method for LFMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper presents a new method to realize high precision range and velocity measurement for linear frequency modulated continuous Wave (LFMCW) radar. By doing interpolation of intermediate frequency signal after FFT processing, the accuracy of range and velocity measurement can be improved. According to the principle of LFMCW radar range and velocity measurement, in order to improve range and velocity measurement accuracy, high precision frequency estimation of intermediate frequency signal of LFMCW radar is needed. Due to noise, clutter, sample rating and other factor, the peak of IF signal spectrum cannot accurately correspond to real frequency, this will cause a relatively large range and velocity measurement error and cannot meet the needs of LFMCW radar in unmanned driving, traffic monitoring and other field. Based on the analysis of two FFT spectral line interpolation, and combined with the characteristics of LFMCW radar range and velocity measurement, by moving the frequency of IF signal, the range and velocity measurement accuracy can be effectively improved. Simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of a Seven-Band Antenna Based on the Ring-Shaped and Composite Fractal Slots
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we present a design of seven-band coupling-fed ring-slotted antenna, which consists of a ring-slotted patch and a defective-structured ground plane with two symmetric B-shaped slots etched on it. This work covers an area of 37.26×28.18 mm^2, which generates seven frequency points at 3.6,3.88,5.38,6.25,7.69,9.78 and 10.36GHz, covering the frequency bands of WLAN and WIMAX standard. Besides, several principles for the design of coupling-fed symmetric antennas are also given in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation Analysis of Improved Channel Access Protocol Based on Load Weight
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to improve the network flexibility of Link-16, the U.S. Army has proposed SHUMA protocol with slot dynamic allocation function. By changing the transmission probability of data, the dynamic allocation of slot resources can be achieved. The network operation of data link network can be realized without prior planning, but its delivery rate is low under the condition of unbalanced load, and the data sent successfully is less. Firstly, this paper analyzes the influence of parameter B on the transmission probability of each node of SHUMA protocol. Then an improved channel access protocol based on load weight is proposed to make parameter B change more smoothly. The protocol improves the average delay and delivery rate, and makes the performance better under the condition of large load to meet the actual needs of different load nodes.

articleTitle: An Efficient High-Precision Data Detection for Massive MU-MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Data detection is among the most crucial process task for massive multi-user (MU) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) wireless systems. In this letter, we propose a novel efficient high precision soft-output data detection algorithm, which iteratively generates a signal vector and reduces its complexity meanwhile. This algorithm guarantees its significant error-rate performance and reduced complexity by combing an optimization method, ADMM, and modified neighborhood search algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed detection achieves superior performance over the existing methods at low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Monitoring Technology of Operating State Software of Charging Pile
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: At present, the number of charging piles is increasing and the distribution position is discrete. It is difficult to manage and maintain after being put into use. For the abnormal work caused by the software operation problem in the pile, this paper proposes a remote monitoring operation mode software method. By monitoring information to analyze problems that occur during software operation, it is easy to maintain and reduce operating costs. According to the hardware and software architecture of the charging pile, this article takes the event as the monitoring object, records it in the work log according to the time of occurrence and uploads it to the background. The log content is the basis of software maintenance. For the log does not involve the information, through the background remote view function to obtain, which enhances the flexibility of maintenance. In addition, the fault warning function is added to realize the fault information reporting and fault generation process.

articleTitle: Fair Use of Collected Energy for Relay Selection Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: For the energy bottleneck introduced by the randomness of relay node energy collection in wireless energy harvesting cooperative communication system, a relay selection method considering the energy consumption fairness (RS-ECF) of relay nodes was proposed. In the method, the energy consumption ratio of each relay node is maintained equal, thereby determining the transmission power of the relay node. The simulation results show that the proposed method can not only improve the average channel capacity of the system, but also improve the energy utilization efficiency. Meanwhile, the relay power is also determined by the relay selection, which can save the computing resources of the system.

articleTitle: Effect of Equipment Layout on Electromagnetic Field Distribution in Engine Room
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Helicopter skin can shield electromagnetic wave to a certain extent. But there are unavoidable holes, slots and cables out of the cabin. According to shielding theory, this will greatly affect the shielding effectiveness of the body. Because there is much small equipment in the cabin, the clutter signal produced by the single machine reflects and oscillates between the equipment and the cabin deck, which will aggravate the electro-magnetic leakage. In addition, in the actual measurement process of shielding effectiveness, the test instrument will also affect the electromagnetic environment near it, making the measurement accuracy decline. Therefore, in order to eliminate the influence of equipment, it is necessary to study its influence law. Based on the study of shielding effectiveness of the airframe itself, the influence of equipment layout on electromagnetic field distribution and shielding effectiveness of the airframe is investigated. Then based on the previous simulation of shielding effectiveness of helicopter skin structure, this paper investigates the influence of equipment layout on shielding effectiveness. By using the simulation software FEKO, the influence of equipment layout on electromagnetic energy distribution characteristics of cabin coupling is studied, and the influence rules of equipment layout and cable layout on electromagnetic coupling energy are summarized.

articleTitle: Design of Electrostatic Discharge Test System Induced by Electromagnetic Field in Space Radiation Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Electrostatic discharge induced by strong electromagnetic field refers to the electrostatic discharge process of spacecraft surface materials, cables, some special structural parts and other areas with low charging potential induced by strong electromagnetic field. In general, the spacecraft surface low charge potential sensitive area of the electric field is weak, and electron energy is lower than the ionization energy of molecules, atoms, collision ionization probability is low, when the strong electromagnetic field action, stimulate low-pressure gas to produce dense plasma, thereby reducing the discharge threshold and induce the generation of electrostatic charge discharge. The establishment of testing method for electrostatic discharge induced by strong electromagnetic field is the premise of research on law and protection method of electrostatic discharge induced by strong electromagnetic field. At present, there are no experimental conditions for the interaction between strong electromagnetic field and space environment in China. Therefore, this article established the strong electromagnetic radiation environment and space radiation environment at the same time, under the action of induced discharge test system, not only to be able to carry out electrostatic discharge, high power microwave, nuclear electromagnetic pulse, ultra-wideband electromagnetic pulse and continuous wave such as strong electromagnetic field radiation studies, but also need to solve the high vacuum environment at the same time for sample production and discharge, the discharge parameters and the effect of real-time monitoring, etc. For the research on the rules of space equipment of strong electromagnetic field induced electrostatic discharge is of great significance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Typical Modes of Relay Protection Defects Based on K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The accurate diagnosis and disposal of relay protection defects play an important role in ensuring the function of relay protection and the safe operation of power systems. As the numerous relay protection devices and circuits and the wide variety of defects, it brings challenges to the accurate diagnosis and disposal of defects. In this paper, based on historical defects, the overall analysis of defects is carried out from the perspective of location, cause and severity of defect. The key quantitative indicators of relay protection defect's characteristics are proposed. Based on K-means algorithm, historical defect's character data is clustered and analyzed. The defects are divided into different categories, and the typical defect mode of relay protection is obtained, which can lay a good foundation for the intelligent diagnosis and overhaul recommendation of defects.

articleTitle: The Method for Enhancing Positioning Accuracy Based on Automatic Identification System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: At present, the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) has become an important satellite navigation system in the maritime domain. Automatic Identification System (AIS) as a tool for safety of navigation and security, it can effectively improve the safety of the vessel and play a very important role in maritime navigation, communications, collision avoidance, sea rescue and other aspects of the investigation. In order to guarantee the marine navigation safety, the GNSS augmentation method based on the AIS is increasingly researched. This paper researches the system structures of two solutions of GNSS augmentation method and transport mechanisms of differential augmentation information correction broadcasted based on AIS. The experimental results show that the proposed method greatly improves the positioning accuracy of offshore moving vessels.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Risk Evaluation of Multinational Interconnection Project Based on Intuitionistic Fuzzy Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Risk evaluation of multinational interconnection projects is of great significance to further promote the coordinated development of economic, energy and environmental sustainability with neighboring countries. Based on this, under the background of China's "The Belt and Road Initiative", the risk assessment indicator system of multinational interconnection projects is established from four dimensions, namely, external policy risk, economic risk, operational risk and environmental risk. Secondly, in view of the prominent characteristics of uncertainty factors, this paper evaluates the risk indicators at different levels with the help of intuitionistic fuzzy set theory. Finally, a case study of China-Kazakhstan multinational power grid interconnection project is carried out. The results show that the multinational power grid interconnection project pays more attention to the impact of economic risks, and the risk indicators such as contract terms, geological conditions and technical adaptability, also need attention, which are helpful to investment in the construction of interconnection projects, so as to improve the overall risk resistance ability of investment projects.

articleTitle: Research into the Development of Fidelity Evaluation Methods for Flight Simulator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: As a good ground simulation equipment, flight simulator has many excellent characteristics and has become the most widely used flight characteristic research and training equipment in the aviation industry. During the design and manufacture, the simulator needs to be evaluated to meet the requirements of research and training. The research on evaluation methods has become the focus of the simulator. According to the research status and progress of fidelity evaluation of simulators, the development trend and main problems in fidelity evaluation were summarized.

articleTitle: Structure and Query Optimization of Relay Protection Data Model Based on Shortest Path Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In recent years, the obtaining of relay protection information is getting more abundant, at the same time, the development of AC/DC hybrid bulk power grid puts forward higher requirements for operation of relay protection. It is necessary to integrate data of different professional systems of relay protection, and to carry out global applications. The optimization condition of the unified relay protection data model directly affect the analysis performance of each applications, and the big data characteristics of the relay protection professional data put forward more urgent requirements for optimizing the data model structure and query sequence. This paper establishes the oriented graph to reflect the data query sequence, mapping the data tables to nodes of graph, the data query sequence to path of graph, and the volume of data tables to length of path, optimizing the model structure and query sequence by the shortest path algorithm, which guarantees the query efficiency of professional applications to massive heterogeneous data. Finally, by taking the actual modeling and query sequence of relay protection data as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.
